home.headline: Learn the rules you actually work under
home.sub: Tax, finance and management courses built on Omani regulation, taught by the people who file these returns.
home.featuredSub: Prices are in Omani rials including VAT, and access does not expire.
home.gapTitle: Why a translated course does not work here
home.gap1Title: The rates and thresholds are different
home.gap1Body: A course built on another country's system teaches you a number that will be wrong on your return.
home.gap2Title: The rial divides into a thousand baisa
home.gap2Body: Templates and calculators built for two decimal places round your amounts wrong.
home.gap3Title: The working week starts on Sunday
home.gap3Body: Deadlines calculated on a Monday to Friday week shift your filing date.
home.certTitle: A certificate with a serial an employer can check
home.certBody: Your name in Arabic and Latin script on the certificate, and a serial that opens a public verification page. Not just a PDF.
home.faq1A: No. You pay once, and later updates to the lessons reach you at no extra cost.
home.faq2Q: Are the courses in Arabic or English?
home.faq2A: Arabic is the base. Some courses have a full English version, and the course page says so before you buy.
home.faq3A: In Omani rials through Thawani: local and international cards, and Apple Pay. The price you see includes VAT.
home.faq4A: No. It is issued by the platform and records that you finished and what you scored. It does not replace an accredited professional qualification.
home.footerTagline: Professional courses built on Omani regulation.

teach.pitchTitle: Teach what you know from practice
teach.pitchSub: If you file the returns, run the tenders or hire the people in the Omani market, you know what a translated course does not contain.
teach.pitch1Body: No approval queue. The course appears in the catalogue the moment you press publish.
teach.pitch2Title: Two languages without doing it twice
teach.pitch2Body: Write the lesson in Arabic and add the English version later. The course publishes with whatever is ready.
teach.pitch3Body: How many started, where they stopped, and which quiz question everyone gets wrong.
